purpose: Private, bounded Phase 3B3 technical demonstration using imagery acquired only through the official Mapillary API. This record is not legal advice, production approval, public-deployment approval or commercial clearance.

coordinate_uncertainty.semantics: A positive conservative ingestion radius selected by the operator; not a Mapillary-supplied accuracy claim.

admission_semantics: GO_WITH_ATTRIBUTION authorizes only the explicitly bounded private pilot's source admission and derived technical index. The Phase 3B1 commercial_use_decision compatibility field does not promote the application or model to commercial or production clearance.
requirements: Use only the official Mapillary Graph API; scraping is prohibited.
Preserve per-image creator attribution, stable Mapillary image ID, source page and CC-BY-SA-4.0 notice.
Never persist access tokens, Authorization headers or temporary signed image URLs.
Keep Mapillary imagery, descriptors and index logically separate from first-party, proprietary, user-media and evidence records.
Hard limits are 2000 images and 2 GiB of downloaded image bytes; no public publication or redistribution.
Reconciliation or revocation must cascade from stable image ID to raw cache, normalized asset, descriptor and index membership.
Production and commercial use remain blocked pending professional legal, privacy and share-alike review.

license.share_alike_review: Required before public, production or commercial deployment

sources.allowed_scope: Bounded private non-production technical demo only
sources.attribution: Per-image creator identifier, source page, Mapillary name and license URL are mandatory
sources.required_next_action: Obtain professional legal/privacy/share-alike review before any broader use
